Hi, it is Lars. Sorry for the voice note, it is faster than writing. So, two things. First, the deadline moved. We now have until the fifteenth, not the eighth, which I think is good news for everybody. Second, and this is the part I want you to think about before Thursday: the client asked whether we can do the whole thing in two phases instead of one. I do not have an opinion yet. I would like to hear yours on the call. That is all. Talk on Thursday.

Hello, this is Bram. I listened to the note from Lars and I want to add one thing before the call. Two phases is possible, but only if we agree now on what goes in phase one. Otherwise everything ends up in phase one and we have solved nothing. I am not against it. I just do not want us to say yes on Thursday and then spend three weeks arguing about the list. So my suggestion is simple: bring your three most important items to the call, and we build the list together in twenty minutes. See you on Thursday.
